children: Christopher Kelly and a group of investors disclosed a 16.6% stake in Sono Group N.V. through a Schedule 13D. The filing, dated September 8, 2026, follows an August 31 letter of intent to combine Sono Group with Sports One, a company formed by Kelly, Paul Misir, and Reince Priebus. The move signals a plan to merge the companies and reshape Sono Group’s board at closing.

The group is backing a proposed business combination between Sono Group and Sports One that would make Sports One public and give its existing holders a "super-majority" of the combined company. If the deal closes, "the members of the board of directors of the Issuer shall resign and the directors designated by Sports One will become the directors," concentrating control with Sports One’s slate.

The parties signed a non-binding letter of intent and must still complete due diligence and definitive agreements, so the deal may not close. Several investors also agreed to 180‑day lock-ups, and certain members obtained a call option to buy preferred shares that convert into ordinary shares, subject to a 4.99% ownership cap unless waived with notice.

Christopher Kelly is an American entrepreneur and attorney known as Facebook’s first Chief Privacy Officer and a longtime technology investor. He invests through Kelly Ventures I LP, focusing on early-stage tech, media, and consumer platforms. Kelly has a track record of backing data-driven businesses and strategic transactions alongside operator-led teams.
